class_name: 対比-般-ノニタイシテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: Sets two facts side by side purely to contrast them, with none of the surprise or grievance that のに carries; the two clauses are simply weighed against each other. Do not confuse it with bare 〜に対して after a noun, which marks the target of an action or attitude (客に対して失礼だ). It leans expository and is far more common in writing, reports and comparisons than in casual talk; a na-adjective needs な (社交的なのに対して); a noun takes なの or, in written style, であるの, and のに対し is the clipped realization typical of written style, のに対しまして the polite one.

examples.ruby: 兄[あに]は口数[くちかず]が多[おお]いのに対[たい]して、弟[おとうと]はほとんど話[はな]さない。
examples.english: The older brother is talkative, whereas the younger one hardly speaks.

examples.ruby: 昨年[さくねん]の売[う]り上[あ]げが伸[の]びたのに対[たい]し、今年[ことし]は横[よこ]ばいだ。
examples.english: Sales grew last year, while this year they have flattened out.

examples.ruby: 都心[としん]の人口[じんこう]が増[ふ]えるのに対[たい]して、地方[ちほう]は減[へ]り続[つづ]けている。
examples.english: The population of the city center is rising, whereas the regions keep losing people.
